# Source and license

Moertelmaier, Manuel; Kasper, Manuel; Clark, Simon (2025). **EIS data of 54 21700 cells**, version 1.0.0. Zenodo. DOI: [10.5281/zenodo.15422339](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15422339).

The source record and all 54 per-cell metadata entries specify **Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)**: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Raw CSV and metadata bytes are retained without modification. The benchmark code, plots and scores are new derived analysis; they are not endorsed by the data creators.

The measurements are from 54 separate 21700 cylindrical NMC811 lithium-ion cells at 30% state of charge, using a Keysight SL1007A Scienlab Battery Test System in galvanostatic mode. Names, instrument and acquisition context are supplied by the source; no new measurements were performed in this work. The metadata describes nominal capacity 5 Ah and NMC/graphite chemistry. No independently qualified calibration uncertainty or new experimental replication is claimed.

`zenodo_record.json` preserves the source API response. `metadata.jsonld` preserves per-device descriptions and licenses. `download_manifest.json` contains source MD5 checksums, verified against downloaded bytes, plus local SHA-256 values. The CSV schema file separately declares Apache-2.0 for that schema; its original bytes and declaration are retained.
